parsed.refutation_attempt: Reviewed the code path from the untrusted source N to any OS command execution. N is only used to compute loop bounds for forking child processes (lines 80‑81) and to size shared memory segments (lines 12‑18). No string or command is constructed or passed to system(), exec*, or a similar OS command invocation. The fork() call on line 89 simply creates a child process without any arguments derived from N, and multiplyMatrixChunk() performs purely arithmetic operations on shared memory (lines 47‑55). Therefore there is no path from N to a command execution sink, and the claim of OS command injection is invalid.
